2921-4009-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-4009-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mox Opal, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

5170-6094-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

360-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
360-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

6791-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6791-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6791-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3464-3657-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Mona Lisa.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Maskwood Nexus, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 3.
643-6705-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

1395-2033-3713-5078.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1284-1491-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-2921-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-2921-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

4771-5660-5705.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
When Myr Scrapling enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-4446-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2438-4446-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2866-4211-4986-6798.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-2736-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-4871-5631-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5631-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

474-4394-4875-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {R}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-3940-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Shantotto and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Shantotto trigger, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

3200-4772-6232.description:
Cast Tamiyo by paying {3}{U}{U}. Tamiyo enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to get its emblem.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tamiyo's emblem triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
2034-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3430-3767-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3767-4289.description:
Activate a Sliver you control by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate the Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4030-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

774-1846-2137-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Islands.
Archelos is untapped.
774-1846-2137-4826.description:
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two Islands to your hand, copying High Tide.
Resolve the copy of High Tide.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two Islands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate the Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Each High Tide that has resolved this turn triggers, adding {U}{U} for each trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.
You may also target any other instant/sorcery on the stack using Uyo to create infinite copies of them.

2303-3003-4432.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts.
2303-3003-4432.description:
Cast Leashling by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Leashling by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, returning Leashling to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

729-2529-4026.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
Vedalkan Mastermind and Elvish Piper do not have summoning sickness.
729-2529-4026.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 1, this combo produces infinite mana.

1734-4050-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

618-1019-2645-5313.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least ten.
618-1019-2645-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Setessan Petitioner with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

306-2104-2493.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
